meta.purpose: Define a derived, target-scoped routing projection over existing action authorities without creating a second debt ledger.

authority.claim_boundary: This projection routes target-repository actions from existing authorities. It does not authorize mutation, prove that missing sources are clean, or move target findings into SAGE product debt.

deduplication.rule: Rows may be deduplicated only when the same source authority emits the same explicit or deterministically derived source identity. Similar text across authorities remains separate evidence.

freshness.rule: A producer timestamp is preserved as a declared observation only. It does not establish currentness without snapshot lineage or a caller freshness basis.
